title: Company Recalls 4.2 Million Tubes of Toothpaste
text:
Company Recalls 4.2 Million Tubes of Toothpaste | NTD Open menu NTD Television U.S. China World Politics Health Business Entertainment Sports More ● LIVE search EN ▼ NTD Television US News Company Recalls 4.2 Million Tubes of Toothpaste
 Deviations from Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations led Pritam International Private Limited of India to voluntarily recall 4,298,900 tubes of the Brush Buddies-brand of toothpaste. By Juliette Fairley | Published: 10/20/2026, 3:41:39 PM EDT Authors of the ATSDR report warn that swallowing toothpaste can account for a large percentage of fluoride exposure for children under 8 years old. (New Africa/Shutterstock) The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announced the recall of dessert-flavored and toy-themed toothpaste sold on eBay and Amazon.
 Concerns about deviations from Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) regulations led Pritam International Private Limited of India to voluntarily recall 4,298,900 tubes of the Brush Buddies brand, according to an Oct. 19 FDA enforcement report. The tubes were initially recalled on Sept. 10 and have since been classified by the FDA as a Class II event.
 The FDA describes a Class II recall event as circumstances in which exposure to the product "may cause temporary or medically reversible adverse health consequences.”
 Manufacturing protocols are taken seriously by the authorities because deviations can lead to microbial contamination, instability, or the inclusion of harmful ingredients, according to Northeastern University professor, food safety expert, and Alliance for Recall Ready Communities adviser Darin Detwiler.
 “Deviations from cGMPs can compromise the integrity of the entire production process," Detwiler told NTD.
 The 17 varieties of toothpaste were distributed by Ashtel Studios of Ontario, California and the brand is sold online on eBay.com and Amazon.com . The market withdrawal is applicable to Brush Buddies, Barbie, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Hot Wheels, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Crayola, Silly Scents, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, My Little Pony Scents Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Vanilla Ice Cream Flavored Toothpaste, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream Flavored Toothpaste, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Cookies 'n Cream Ice Cream Flavored Toothpaste, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Chocolate Ice Cream Flavored Toothpaste, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; evo, Advanced Whitening, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste, evo, Sensitive, Anticavity Fluoride Toothpaste; Brush Buddies, Whitening Anti-cavity Fluoride Toothpaste, with Baking Soda,  BB Cavity Protection, Anti-Cavity Flouride Toothpaste; BB Advanced Whitening, Anti-Cavity Fluoride Toothpaste; ARU, Toothpaste, Gum Health, Soothing Mint; and ARU, Toothpaste, Cavity Protection, 9 Ingredients, Cool Mint.
 The FDA website states that cGMP regulations advocate for adequately controlled manufacturing operations, which include establishing strong quality management systems, obtaining appropriate quality raw materials, establishing robust operating procedures, detecting and investigating product quality deviations, and maintaining reliable testing laboratories. Further, Detwiler said cGMP regulations were established to set baseline standards that manufacturers are legally required to follow to ensure product quality, cleanliness, consistency, and safety.
 “While a violation might not always result in immediate health threats, when a recall of this size happens, it means the FDA and the company found enough of a potential risk—such as contamination or quality failure—that it wasn’t worth gambling with public safety,” he added.
